hooks.command: stp_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { echo "[UNVERIFIED] Codex Stop: Git root unavailable" >&2; exit 1; }; if [ ! -x "$stp_root/.venv/bin/python" ]; then echo "[UNVERIFIED] Codex Stop: project .venv missing" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$stp_root/.venv/bin/python" "$stp_root/tools/dev/codex_stop_check.py" typecheck
hooks.commandWindows: $stpRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[UNVERIFIED] Codex Stop: Git root unavailable"); exit 1 }; $stpPython = Join-Path $stpRoot ".venv/Scripts/python.exe"; if (!(Test-Path $stpPython -PathType Leaf)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[UNVERIFIED] Codex Stop: project .venv missing"); exit 1 }; & $stpPython (Join-Path $stpRoot "tools/dev/codex_stop_check.py") typecheck; exit $LASTEXITCODE
